hypothesis: A team whose net-points-per-game advantage over its opponent exceeds the model's own fair spread by more than a frozen edge threshold is a candidate.
signal_rule: Signal only if the originated spread deviates from the graded reference line by at least the frozen minimum edge AND every gate in required_gates is open.
own_line_method: Originated spread from verified PF/PA per game (NFL3-S05) and the verified slate (NFL3-S07).
inputs_verified: Verified: 32 standings rows and all 14 Week 10 games. Not verified: the edge threshold, which is a declared parameter and has not been fitted.

hypothesis: A matchup of a high points-for team against a high points-against team produces a total above the model's own fair total.
signal_rule: Signal only if the gap between the model total and the reference total clears the frozen threshold and the calibration gates pass.
own_line_method: Originated total from verified PF/PA per game (NFL3-S05).
inputs_verified: Verified: 32 standings rows, and the model total is checked against the league's own points-per-game. Not verified: the threshold and any reference total.

hypothesis: The model's win probability for the home side, once a victory-margin distribution is licensed and fitted, will be compared to the reference price.
signal_rule: Blocked until a margin-distribution parameter exists (flag NFL3-F08); no probability is published and no selection may be graded.
own_line_method: Originated margin from verified PF/PA per game; the margin distribution is NOT available from any official source in this pack.
inputs_verified: Verified: the point margin inputs. Missing: the margin-distribution parameter, so this strategy cannot produce a price at all.

hypothesis: Only markets that are not within the league's objectionable categories are eligible; injury-tied and officiating-tied markets are permanently excluded.
signal_rule: Eligibility gate G11 is applied before any modelling: a prop family tied to injuries or officiating is rejected by construction.
own_line_method: Eligibility rule taken from the NFL's own release (NFL3-S02); no prop line data is captured anywhere in this pack.
inputs_verified: Verified: the eligibility rule text. Missing: every prop line, every player-level dataset, and every settlement rule.
correlation_pair: Within-same-player markets share one performer and must never be treated as independent

hypothesis: When a 1st-string player at a skill position is ruled Out, the next listed string's usage share rises; this is a usage hypothesis, not a price hypothesis.
signal_rule: Requires a licensed snap-share and target-share history; both are absent, so no value is produced.
own_line_method: Depth ordering from the club charts (NFL3-S09, NFL3-S10) and designations from the official report (NFL3-S08).
inputs_verified: Verified: the depth ordering and the designations. Missing: any usage-share history, so the hypothesis is untestable here.
correlation_pair: Backup usage is negatively dependent on the starter's own prop

hypothesis: A quarterback's passing market and his receiver's receiving market are positively dependent; pricing them as independent misprices the joint event.
signal_rule: The joint price is produced only from a measured dependence; no independence assumption is permitted anywhere in this catalog.
own_line_method: Dependence method defined on the Correlations page; the measured rho stays blank until a paired licensed history exists (flag NFL3-F09).
inputs_verified: Verified: the method and the eight league-level correlations measured from official data. Missing: any measured dependence for this pair.
correlation_pair: QB passing yards vs WR receiving yards

hypothesis: A running back's rushing market and his own team's total are positively dependent through game script.
signal_rule: Joint price from a measured dependence only; independence is never assumed.
own_line_method: Dependence method defined on the Correlations page; the measured rho stays blank until a paired licensed history exists (flag NFL3-F09).
inputs_verified: Verified: the method. Missing: any measured dependence for this pair.
correlation_pair: RB rushing yards vs own team total

hypothesis: Legs drawn from different games are treated as independent only after an empirical test; independence is a claim to be tested, not an input.
signal_rule: Cross-game dependence must be estimated from graded history before any multi-leg price is published.
own_line_method: Slate from NFL3-S07; no graded history exists yet.
inputs_verified: Verified: the 14-game slate. Missing: graded leg outcomes, so no dependence can be estimated.
correlation_pair: Game A margin vs Game B margin

hypothesis: The home cover event and the over event share the same scoring process and are dependent, in a direction that depends on which team leads.
signal_rule: The joint price requires the measured same-game dependence; blank until measured.
own_line_method: Model margin and total from verified PF/PA per game (NFL3-S05).
inputs_verified: Verified: the model margin and total inputs. Missing: the measured same-game dependence.

hypothesis: A strategy that cannot beat the closing price is not a skill strategy, no matter what its win rate looks like in a small sample.
signal_rule: CLV is computed only against licensed closing prices; none are held, so the column stays blank.
own_line_method: No licensed price archive is configured (flag NFL3-F10).
inputs_verified: Verified: the definition and the reason it matters. Missing: every closing price.
